from sympy import primefactors

def get_a_n(n_max):
    a = [0] * (n_max + 1)
    a[1] = 10
    for n in range(1, n_max):
        a[n+1] = 6 * a[n] - 2**(n+2) - 3**(n+1) + 5
    return a[1:]

a_vals = get_a_n(20)
all_factors = set()
for i, val in enumerate(a_vals):
    factors = primefactors(val)
    print(f"a_{i+1} factors: {factors}")
    all_factors.update(factors)

print(f"All prime factors: {sorted(list(all_factors))}")
